label: Knowledge Mapping
definition: Representing concepts relationships evidence pathways and gaps so a knowledge system can be reviewed and improved

label: Conceptual Model
definition: A structured representation of how a domain problem or inquiry is understood

label: Taxonomy
definition: A controlled classification structure for categories and concepts

label: Ontology
definition: A formal model of entities classes properties and relationships

label: Knowledge Graph
definition: A graph representation of knowledge objects and typed semantic relationships

label: Metadata
definition: Structured contextual information supporting retrieval provenance and governance

label: Evidence Map
definition: A map connecting claims concepts methods and sources to evidence

label: Repository
definition: A structured folder of code data documentation and outputs supporting reproducible work

label: AI-Assisted Retrieval
definition: Retrieval workflows that use structured knowledge to ground AI-assisted outputs
